name: io.github.mkemeter/obsidian-vaultgate-mcp
title: VaultGate
description: Connect your Obsidian vault to any AI assistant — zero plugins, full privacy.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Target vault name. When set, every CLI command targets this vault. Leave unset if you only have one vault.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_CLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path (or bare name) of the Obsidian CLI binary. Defaults to "obsidian".

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port for the HTTP transport (1-65535). Defaults to 3001. Always bound to 127.0.0.1 only.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_CONTEXT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Bare .md filename (vault root) used as the vault conventions file. Defaults to "VAULTGATE.md".
